name: @haksanlulz/mcp-nychousing
description: MCP server over NYC Open Data (Socrata/SODA) for NYC housing data: HPD violations, complaints, and litigation, building ownership two ways (HPD registration and the property record: PLUTO assessment roll, ACRIS deeds/mortgages, Speculation Watch List), landlord portfolios, DOB records, 311 heat complaints, marshal evictions, and a one-call building profile. Built for tenant organizers, housing-court legal aid, and Right-to-Counsel orgs.
author: Abishai James

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
